name: sharepoint-knowledge-workbench
description: Independently-installable domain plugins for the SharePoint Knowledge Workbench: content-extraction, content-structure-analysis, content-assembly, and content-rendering convert source manuals into validated structured content (Markdown/ASPX); sharepoint-* plugins provide comprehensive discovery, schema reconciliation, tenant provisioning, content publication, page modernization, link remediation, wave planning, SPFx development, and Copilot agent management; workbench-setup provides foundational environment configuration.

plugins.name: sharepoint-content-publication
plugins.description: SharePoint tenant publication tooling: packages rendered publication output, reconciles tenant state, and builds safe human-reviewed SPO Site Page copy/promotion plans (never raw .aspx upload). Real PnP executors exist for page creation/upload, markdown/file publishing, rollback, page conversion, and post-deployment validation -- each dry-run by default, real writes gated behind -Execute plus a plan-derived confirmation token.

plugins.name: sharepoint-link-remediation
plugins.description: Generic SharePoint link extraction, rewrite-rule remediation, and post-migration link-integrity validation. Extraction and validation are read-only; the 3 write-capable remediation skills (page links, document-content links, field image references) are dry-run by default and each have a real PnP executor requiring -Execute plus a confirmation token.

plugins.name: sharepoint-discovery
plugins.description: Read-only analysis of exported classic SharePoint inventories and schemas: per-page migration complexity scoring, functional grouping of web-part code, schema drift auditing, choice field inventory, and calculated column extraction.

plugins.name: sharepoint-page-modernization
plugins.description: Analyses and converts legacy classic SharePoint pages into modern-page conversion manifests: component inventory, classification, data-driven layout selection, component mapping with explicit gap notices, and a human-readable Markdown conversion report. Produces plans, never tenant writes.

plugins.name: sharepoint-page-modernization-execution
plugins.description: Real PnP.PowerShell page modernization executors: single page conversion, bulk conversion, page copying between sites, and post-conversion validation.

plugins.name: sharepoint-schema-reconciliation
plugins.description: Declarative, JSON-schema-driven SharePoint site-column, content-type, and list/library provisioning reconciliation. Reconcile-not-recreate semantics, a raw Field XML workaround for calculated/lookup/user columns, and duplicate-title detection before any delete. Planning is pure; a real apply is dry-run by default and requires both an explicitly injected executor and a plan-derived confirmation token. Zero tenant I/O ships in this plugin (enforced by a test) -- the real PnP executors for these plans live in sharepoint-provisioning instead.

plugins.name: sharepoint-provisioning
plugins.description: Real PnP.PowerShell executors for granular CRUD and declarative site-column, list-column, content-type, view, item, list, library, site, branding, navigation, permissions, and taxonomy provisioning. 19 dedicated execution skills: dry-run by default; every write gated behind -Execute and an operation-specific -ConfirmToken.

plugins.name: sharepoint-migration-planning
plugins.description: Plans a SharePoint site migration end-to-end across four implemented skills: project setup (config.psd1 confirmation + working directory), site-inventory export validation (lookup-target normalization), deterministic dependency-graph analysis and deployment wave-order computation (Stage 3a, gated by completeness checks that catch a matrix silently not matching the source it claims to describe, reusing sharepoint-provisioning's wave_planning.py directly), and generated wave deployment scripts plus a human wave guide (Stage 3b, one wave at a time -- never an unattended run-everything script).

plugins.name: sharepoint-content-migration
plugins.description: Item-level SharePoint content (list-item data) migration mechanism: batched migration with retry, and the two-pass lookup-ID re-link technique (record source-to-destination IDs during a content pass, resolve lookup fields against that mapping once target lists exist). Distinct from sharepoint-provisioning (schema/list/field structure, not row data). Planning is pure; a real apply is dry-run by default and requires both an explicitly injected executor and a plan-derived confirmation token -- a real PnP executor (non-batched item create plus identity-based backfill update) is implemented.

plugins.name: sharepoint-spfx-authoring
plugins.description: Authors, packages, and deploys custom SPFx web parts for SharePoint Online: a Master-Detail dossier scaffolder plus a generic, interactive scaffolding skill for any new web part (toolchain check, requirements Q&A, Yeoman generator run, customization guidance), production build/packaging into a verified .sppkg, Site Collection App Catalog provisioning guidance (BC Gov ServiceNow ticket path vs. direct trial-tenancy PnP path), and PnP-based deployment/verification of the packaged solution.
